name: Sleepless
source:
Nox struggles with her day-to-day life as her unwavering sleep disorders take control of her relationships and make her question reality.

[From [url=https://displayer.itch.io/sleepless]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
諾克斯艱難地應付著每一天。頑固不去的睡眠障礙左右著她與他人的關係，甚至讓她開始懷疑現實。
